batch_composition_dependence.finding: D4 W2-D9, re-measured on this model copy rather than cited
batch_composition_dependence.how_this_record_avoids_it: every source here is embedded window by window on its own, so a difference between a clean and a transformed vector can only come from the transformation

measured.how: the same text embedded on its own, then as the second member of a batch whose first member is longer, so it is padded to the longer length

batch_composition_dependence.why_the_hashes_here_are_not_the_sealed_o: the campaign encoded in batches of 64 under the fitting bounds; this encodes one window at a time under bounds fitted on the sample. Both halves of every comparison are encoded the same way, which is what the comparison needs, and neither is comparable to a S21D5-025 seal

chronology.bounds_fitted_on: the clean bodies of the sample, never on the transformed set

premises.the_ranker_is_a_deterministic_function_o: pairwise-contrastive-linear-v1 projects each candidate onto one direction and breaks ties on the baseline order

ranker_dependent_form.why_not_a_second_run: a ranker whose input is four vectors and a slot order cannot move when neither moves. Re-ranking the transformed sample under the fitted direction would produce the same ordering by construction and would report it as if it were an observation. S21D5-035 reads the two premises above rather than a re-run

first_action.reading: with no fitted ranker in force the first action is the head of the baseline order; this compares the body the system would act on first by its canonical identity

independence.reading: 160 transformed candidate vectors, every one identical to its clean counterpart, so the 40 transformed decisions repeat 20 clean ones and add none. This is the number S21D5-023 sealed as zero and the property this regression tests

purpose: execute the claim S21D5-023 sealed about D5's own calibration corpus: a transformation repeats its source group's fitted feature vector, so it adds no independent decision

semantic_mutation_control.why: the invariance result above says a rename does not move the canonical bytes. This says a changed meaning does. Without it, a canonicaliser that mapped every program to one value would satisfy the first claim completely

submanifest.sample_is_drawn_from: the D5 calibration catalogue — twenty of the hundred groups authored for this sprint, so the property is measured on the corpus the selection will be certified on rather than on a predecessor's

verifier.how: plain pytest in a scratch directory. A precheck that wrote governed outcomes would put transformed rows in the store the clean campaign owns
